feature: Components guides open the original with Edit Original
summary: The three Components guides that change a component (Use it again and again, Override one copy, A button in all its states) now have you right-click a button and choose Edit Original, ring the Done button in the title bar when it is time to go back, and run from first card to last again.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Help > Tutorials, Components track. Walks: tutorial-use-it-again-and-again-walk, tutorial-override-one-copy-walk, tutorial-component-versions-walk.

try.do: Start Use it again and again and double click the Save Button tile twice to put two copies down.
Right-click any button and choose Edit Original: the card moves on and points at the colour section.
Double click the box, pick another colour, and read the card now ringing Done in the title bar.
Press Done and watch every copy repaint on the page.
Start Override one copy: Edit Original on the top button, Add > Label Wording, Done, then click the middle button and type new words.
Start A button in all its states and build Hover, Pressed and Disabled inside Edit Original until the card rings Done.
Press Done and pick a state from the copy's State row.

evaluate: Does 'right-click a button and choose Edit Original' read as the obvious way to reach the original?
Is the card beside Done clear that pressing it is what takes you back to the page?
In the states guide, does showing all four states on the original's own page, then a copy picking one back on the page, land the lesson as well as the old ending did?
Is it clear on the first card of each guide that every button on the page is a copy?
rough: In the states guide the card under Done covers the Hover label of the top right drawing while it is up.
The original's own page is drawn on the dark see-through backdrop rather than on a page, so the button sits on black; that came with Edit Original and is left as the previous task logged it.
The states guide is at its eight card budget, so its last card asks you to pick a state from the copy's row without waiting for you to do it.
